description: Delete each product's eBay draft and create a fresh one from its current data, for up to 25 products. Needed only when a draft must move to another category or eBay site, or the reason is ebayDraftOfferMissing or ebayNoOfferId — ordinary edits are picked up by publish_ebay_drafts. A live listing is refused. If the delete succeeds but the new draft fails, that product is left with no draft and its failure says so. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: Omit this when the eBay connection sells on exactly one marketplace — the server fills it in automatically. Pass one of the audit's armed ebayDraftSetup.marketplaceIds only when several are armed. This is a MARKETPLACE id (e.g. EBAY_DE) — never the eBay CONNECTION/adapter id.

productIds.description: Delete each product's existing eBay draft offer and create a fresh one from its CURRENT data, at most 25 ids fetched with search_products. Use this when a draft must move to a different category or marketplace, or eBay rejected its offer and a plain retry will not fix it. A LIVE listing is refused. If the delete succeeds but the new create fails, the failure says so explicitly — that product is then on the channel with NO draft.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
